user.title: in-lite Account
user.description: Enter the email address associated with your in-lite account. A verification code will be sent to this address.

verify.title: Verification Code
verify.description: We sent a verification code to **{email}**. Enter the 6-digit code below.

select_garden.title: Select Garden
select_garden.description: Your account has multiple gardens. Select the one you want to set up.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm Device
bluetooth_confirm.description: An in-lite hub was discovered nearby. Would you like to set it up?

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for **{email}** need to be updated. Press submit to re-authenticate.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the in-lite cloud service. Please try again.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid or expired verification code. Please check and try again.
error.no_gardens: No gardens found on this account.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

init.title: in-lite Options
init.description: Configure polling and connection behavior. A longer idle disconnect keeps the BLE connection alive to receive real-time state updates from the hub (for example, physical button presses).
